name: Door God: Heavenly Official Presenting a Banner Reading "Wan Fu Lai Chao" ("Plentiful Blessings Are Arriving")
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；early 20th century；Woodblock print; ink and color on paper; with printed shop inscription reading "Ju Zao" ("Shop Made", note: the print shop name should be in its pairing print). Probably from Xi'an, Shaanxi.
